meta.name: gstack-document-generate
meta.description: GStack document generation method for turning implementation, product, or operational work into durable docs with clear audience and ownership.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将实施、产品或运营工作转化为持久的文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把工作成果系统化地整理成文档并明确读者和责任人
copy.tagline_en: Turn implementation, product, or operational work into durable docs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically document work outcomes with clear audience and ownership

howto.what: Claude 会根据你的需求，生成面向特定读者和负责人的文档，包括目标、大纲、内容变更和验证说明。
howto.when: 当需要把工作成果变成持久文档，或者发布/功能缺少用户或内部文档时触发。你也可以直接说“$gstack-document-generate”来调用。

say.text: 帮我为这个新功能生成用户文档。
say.note: Claude 会产出文档目标、大纲和内容。

say.text: 把这次架构决策写成持久文档。
say.note: Claude 会明确读者和负责人。

say.text: 这个发布缺少内部文档，帮我补上。
say.note: Claude 会生成文档并附验证说明。

howto.what_en: Claude generates durable docs with clear audience and ownership, including target, outline, content changes, and validation notes.
howto.when_en: Use when work should become durable docs, or a release/feature lacks user/internal documentation. Also triggered by explicit invocation "$gstack-document-generate".

say_en.text: Generate user docs for this new feature.
say_en.note: Claude will produce doc target, outline, and content.

say_en.text: Turn this architecture decision into durable docs.
say_en.note: Claude will specify audience and owner.

say_en.text: This release lacks internal docs, please fill in.
say_en.note: Claude will generate docs with validation notes.
